module.summary: RTT-Inside drift-bounded structural report for ERCOT Dallas / Fort Worth Metro cluster — the most mature colocation and interconnection ecosystem in ERCOT, anchored by Digital Realty, Equinix, QTS, AT&T, and Lumen.

ai.module.description: Cluster-level module manifest for ERCOT Dallas / Fort Worth Metro. Covers 17 facilities including Digital Realty campuses, Equinix IBX nodes, QTS Fort Worth, AT&T edge nodes, Lumen transport hubs, and regional enterprise compute. Includes RTT operator scores, drift/coherence envelopes, facility list, and navigation pointers.

cluster_mapping.cluster.name: Dallas / Fort Worth Metro
cluster_mapping.cluster.notes: Major interconnection hub; dense metro fiber routes; most mature colocation ecosystem in ERCOT; steady enterprise and colocation growth.

rtt.envelopes.drift.description: Steady enterprise and colocation growth; metro constraints limit explosive expansion.
rtt.envelopes.coherence.description: Mature fiber routes, stable enterprise ecosystem, strong interconnection fabric.
